throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86srli.d $r12, 1; x86srli.d $r13, 1; x86srli.d $r14, 1; x86srli.d $r15, 1; x86srli.d $r16, 1; x86srli.d $r17, 1; x86srli.d $r18, 1; x86srli.d $r19, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'x86mtflag $r0, 1' --asm 'x86srli.d $r12, 1; x86srli.d $r13, 1; x86srli.d $r14, 1; x86srli.d $r15, 1; x86srli.d $r16, 1; x86srli.d $r17, 1; x86srli.d $r18, 1; x86srli.d $r19, 1'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 16.01 cycles. The measured CPI 2.0013 is the nominal 2 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LBT x86-style instruction with an immediate operand. Latency is recorded for the rd accumulator path and the EFLAGS path. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
